title: Compile, Format, and Visualize Sensor String Data
text: CMAR’s Coastal Monitoring Program measures Essential Ocean Variables around coast Nova Scotia, Canada. program three branches: Water Quality, Currents Waves. sensorstrings backbone Water Quality data pipeline. Processed data can viewed downloaded described CMAR Data Access Reference Sheet. Water Quality data collected vertical moorings called sensor strings. typical string rope anchored seafloor held sub-surface buoy, sensors attached different depths. Sensors may also attached surface buoys, equipment, floating docks fixed structures (Figure 1). Figure 1: Sensor string configurations (scale).  Every string least one temperature sensor, dissolved oxygen sensor. Sensors string may also measure salinity, pH, chlorophyll, sensor depth tilt. Strings deployed location several months record every 10 minutes 1 hour, depending sensor.

text: sensor type exports data different columns headers. sensorstrings provides functions organize, compile, format, visualize data. sensorstrings built CMAR’s workflow, anyone data sensors can use .
